entities.name: The Edge
entities.description: A ring-like toroid universe surrounding the known Multiverse and bordering the Blind Eternities; the science-fantasy setting of Edge of Eternities.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes; the Edge's Chaos Wall is likely a layer of it, and FTL travel through the Weft passes through it.

entities.name: Multiverse
entities.description: The known multiverse that the Edge surrounds, of which the Edge's inhabitants are unaware.

entities.name: Chaos Wall
entities.description: The tangible inner boundary of the Edge, where matter, space and time seem to originate; pierced for faster-than-light travel.

entities.name: Quiet Wall
entities.description: The constantly expanding, unobservable outer boundary of the Edge.

entities.name: Pinnacle
entities.description: The intergalactic alliance that governs a large part of the Edge and builds the eternity columns.

entities.name: Monoists
entities.description: A faith, founded by Susurians, seeking the death of the Edge as paradise by turning stars into supervoids.

entities.name: Summists
entities.description: The expansionist faith whose state is the Celestial Palatinate, secretly founded by Astelli.

entities.name: Entropy War
entities.description: The conflict between the Monoists and Summists across the Edge.

entities.name: Kavaronic Federal Empire
entities.description: The empire of Kav, seeking refuge from their collapsing planet Kavaron.

entities.name: Eumidians
entities.description: Humanoid insects, the most common sentient species in the Edge, spreading via seedships.

entities.name: Illvoi Bloom
entities.description: Jellyfish-like beings capable of cloudsculpting; their Uthros Combine secretly researches Eldrazi.

entities.name: Susurians
entities.description: Massive vampiric beings from the Susur system who command gravity and founded Monoism.

entities.name: Astelli
entities.description: Angels or incarnations of mana made from the remains of stars killed by supervoids; secret founders of Summism.

entities.name: Drix
entities.description: An ancient species able to travel through the Weft independently.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Multiverse beings that have accessed the Edge.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker from the Multiverse who has accessed the Edge.

entities.name: Oscillus Cail
entities.description: Owner of Cail Station.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: A star system whose dying star was coerced by Monoists into a supervoid, the primary setting of Edge of Eternities.

entities.name: Susur Secundi
entities.description: The planet closest to Sothera, claimed by Monoists.

entities.name: Kavaron
entities.description: A terrestrial planet shattered by the Kav's industrial strip mining for moxite.

entities.name: Evendo
entities.description: A planet terraformed at its equator by Evendo-strain Eumidians.

entities.name: Uthros
entities.description: A gas giant that is the hub of the Uthros Combine's research complex.

entities.name: Joska
entities.description: A pristine moon where Celestial Palatinate colonists were massacred, breaking the negotiated peace.

entities.name: Starshadow
entities.description: An empty world whose population was annihilated in a day by an unknown cause.

entities.name: Cail Station
entities.description: An abandoned station with an arcade and docking bay, evacuated around 4544 AR.

entities.name: Point Prime
entities.description: The supervoid that was once Susur; the first and most holy supervoid of the Monoist faith.

entities.name: Celestial Palatinate
entities.description: A monarchical Summist state led by the Regent Maximum, warring with Monoists.

entities.name: Eternity ships
entities.description: The only ships capable of FTL travel through the Weft, using an eternity drive and Pinnacle-built columns.

events.summary: Cail Station is evacuated around 4544 AR, prioritizing mining equipment over its Human and Eumidian residents.
events.quote: Around 4544 AR , the station was evacuated, prioritizing its expensive, specialized mining equipment over the lives of its Human and Eumidian residents.

events.summary: Monoists coerce Sothera's dying star into becoming a supervoid.
events.quote: a dying star which was coerced into becoming a supervoid by Monoists

events.summary: The Kav's industrial strip mining for moxite shatters Kavaron into two halves.
events.quote: A terrestrial planet that was shattered by the Kav's industrial strip mining for moxite, splitting it into two halves.

events.summary: A population on Starshadow is annihilated in a day by an unknown cause.
events.quote: An empty world with the remains of a population that was annihilated in a day by an unknown cause.

events.summary: Celestial Palatinate colonists are massacred on Joska, breaking the negotiated peace in the Entropy War.
events.quote: After three hundred Celestial Palatinate colonists were massacred here, the negotiated peace in the Entropy War was broken.

events.summary: Eumidians on Evendo leave hibernation because meteors from crumbling Kavaron heat the planet.
events.quote: Left hibernation recently due to the heating of Evendo from meteors originating from the crumbling planet Kavaron.

relations.quote: Originally from the Susur system, they are the founding species of Monoism .
Secret founders of Summism worshipped within the faith.
a conflict known as the Entropy War between two religious factions, the all-consuming Monoists and the expansionist Summists, rages across the Edge
Point Prime , the supervoid that was once Susur .

relations.note: the Uthros Combine secretly researches Eldrazi
governs Pinnacle Space, a large part of the Edge
relations.quote: Pinnacle is the governing body of a large part of the Edge, referred to as Pinnacle Space.
